participants.code: <block wx:if="{{sheet === 'participants'}}"><text class="body-text">{{record.capacityLabel}}</text><text class="meta">{{locale === 'en' ? 'Only public profiles returned by the event are shown. This is not the complete registration list.' : '仅展示活动返回的公开参与者资料，并非完整报名名单。'}}</text><ui-identity-row wx:for="{{record.participants}}" wx:key="owner" data-route="member" data-id="{{item.owner}}" bind:press="navigate" src="{{(item.avatar_url) || ''}}" name="{{item.display_name}}" description="" navigation="{{true}}" interactive="{{true}}"/><text wx:if="{{!record.participants.length}}" class="meta">{{locale === 'en' ? 'No public participants to show yet' : '暂无可展示的公开参与者'}}</text></block>

<block wx:elif="{{sheet === 'mini'}}"><text class="brand mini-logo">706</text><ui-action-row data-kind="about" bind:press="sheet" label="{{sheetCopy.titles.about}}" navigation="{{true}}"/><ui-action-row bind:press="reloadPage" label="{{locale === 'en' ? 'Reload page' : '重新加载页面'}}"/><ui-action-row data-route="feedback" bind:press="navigate" label="{{t.feedback}}" navigation="{{true}}"/></block>

<block wx:elif="{{sheet === 'manage'}}"><ui-action-row data-route="edit-entity" data-id="{{record.id}}" bind:press="navigate" label="{{t.edit}}" navigation="{{true}}"/><ui-action-row data-route="approvals" bind:press="navigate" label="{{t.approvals}}" navigation="{{true}}"/><ui-action-row wx:if="{{record.can_admin}}" data-route="admins" data-id="{{record.id}}" bind:press="navigate" label="{{t.admins}}" navigation="{{true}}"/></block>

<block wx:elif="{{sheet === 'member'}}"><ui-action-row data-value="{{'/pages/member/index?id=' + record.owner}}" bind:press="copy" label="{{locale === 'en' ? 'Copy profile link' : '复制主页链接'}}"/><ui-action-row wx:if="{{record.owner !== currentUser && record.muted}}" data-op="mute" data-id="{{record.owner}}" data-block-id="{{record.block_id}}" data-enabled="0" disabled="{{busy}}" loading="{{busy}}" bind:press="action" label="{{t.unmute}}"/><ui-action-row wx:elif="{{record.owner !== currentUser}}" data-op="mute" data-id="{{record.owner}}" disabled="{{busy}}" loading="{{busy}}" bind:press="action" label="{{t.mute}}"/><ui-action-row wx:if="{{platformAdmin && record.owner !== currentUser}}" data-op="grantPlatformAdmin" data-id="{{record.owner}}" disabled="{{busy}}" loading="{{busy}}" bind:press="action" label="{{t.grantAdmin}}"/><ui-action-row data-kind="report" bind:press="sheet" label="{{t.report}}" navigation="{{true}}"/></block>

relation-kind-and-metadata.code: function typeLabel(item={},locale){const en=locale==='en';if(item.kind==='SPACE')return en?'Space':'空间';if(item.kind==='ORGANIZATION')return en?'Organization':'组织';if(item.type==='Group'||item.type==='entity')return en?'Group':'小组';if(item.type==='User'||item.type==='profile'||item.type==='person'||item.route==='member')return en?'Person':'个人';return '';}

<ui-identity-row wx:elif="{{route === 'relations' || route === 'following' || route === 'entity-members'}}" data-index="{{index}}" bind:press="openItem" src="{{(item.avatar_url) || ''}}" name="{{item.display_name || item.name}}" description="{{item.identityMeta}}" type-label="{{item.relationTypeLabel}}" interactive="{{true}}"><view slot="actions"><ui-button wx:if="{{item.relationTargetId !== currentUser}}" data-id="{{item.relationTargetId}}" data-enabled="{{!item.following}}" catch:press="personFollow" variant="secondary" compact="{{true}}" label="{{item.following ? (locale === 'en' ? 'Following' : '已关注') : t.follow}}"/></view></ui-identity-row>

removed-space-links.code: const links=editorial.entityLinks(r,route==='org'),hosts=await Promise.all(links.hosts.map(async link=>{try{const host=await this.read('member',{id:link.user_id});return {...host,roleLabel:p.locale==='en'?(link.role_en||'Host'):(link.role||'负责人')};}catch{return null;}}));

<ui-menu-group wx:if="{{route === 'org' && entityContent.account}}" flush><ui-action-row bind:press="openOfficial" label="{{entityContent.account.label}}" description="{{locale === 'en' ? 'WeChat official account' : '组织公众号'}}" navigation="{{true}}"/></ui-menu-group>

<view wx:if="{{route === 'org' && entityContent.recaps.length}}" class="entity-stories"><view class="section-heading"><text>{{locale === 'en' ? 'Organization stories' : '组织回顾'}}</text><ui-button wx:if="{{entityContent.recaps.length > 2}}" bind:press="toggleRecaps" variant="secondary" compact="{{true}}" label="{{showAllRecaps ? (locale === 'en' ? 'Show less' : '收起') : t.view}}"/></view><ui-menu-group wx:if="{{entityContent.recaps.length}}" flush><block wx:for="{{entityContent.recaps}}" wx:key="label"><ui-action-row wx:if="{{showAllRecaps || index < 2}}" data-index="{{index}}" bind:press="openRecap" label="{{item.label}}" description="{{item.published_at}}{{item.demo ? (locale === 'en' ? ' · Demo story' : ' · 演示文章') : ''}}" icon="{{item.cover_url}}"/></block></ui-menu-group></view>

form-spacing.code: <block wx:if="{{route === 'feedback'}}"><ui-panel context="canvas" inset="none" layout="form"><ui-form-field standalone disabled="{{busy}}" data-key="reason" value="{{sheetForm.reason}}" placeholder="{{t.reason}}" type="area" bind:input="sheetInput" bind:keyboardheightchange="keyboardChange"/><ui-button data-kind="report" bind:press="sheet" variant="primary" block disabled="{{busy}}" loading="{{busy}}" label="{{t.feedback}}"/></ui-panel></block>

<block wx:elif="{{sheet === 'return'}}"><ui-panel context="canvas" inset="none" layout="form"><ui-form-field standalone data-key="note" value="{{sheetForm.note}}" placeholder="{{t.note}}" type="area" bind:input="sheetInput" bind:keyboardheightchange="keyboardChange"/><ui-button data-op="review" data-approve="{{false}}" loading="{{busy}}" disabled="{{busy}}" bind:press="action" variant="primary" block label="{{locale === 'en' ? 'Send requested changes' : '发送修改意见'}}"/></ui-panel></block>
